project_name: Prime Storage Powers Ferry Place Marietta Data Center Conversion
developer: Prime Storage Powers Ferry Place Marietta LLC / Prime Group Holdings
status_detail: Prime Storage filed to convert part of the existing self-storage facility at 1155 Powers Ferry Place into a data center; Planning Commission recommended approval 4-3, but City Council tabled the proposal in July 2026 while also approving a temporary moratorium on new data centers through Dec. 31, 2026.

Local Moultrie Observer coverage reports the Colquitt County Commission voted unanimously at its June 2, 2026 meeting to impose a moratorium on data center construction. developer: Google (sole end-user/operator announced); underlying developer not confirmed in county release
status_detail: Columbia County announced on July 23, 2026 a strategic partnership with Google and Georgia Power for a data center project; county says Google will pay 100% of associated energy costs and restrictive covenants will govern noise, lighting, footprint, visibility, water supply, and end-of-life strategy. Local reporting says Google will occupy two data center complexes being built near Appling/Harlem with 33 buildings across about 3,500 acres.
notes: Google's Georgia data center page lists a 2026 milestone announcing plans for a new Columbia County data center. DCD/WRDW report roughly 8 million sq ft / 33 buildings, but MW not found in official county release.

aliases: Blockstream Cook County Bitcoin mining facility
status_detail: Baxtel lists Blockstream Adel GA as operational, year built 2019, and describes a large Bitcoin mining facility in Cook County used for hosted and own mining operations; Baxtel company summary shows 40 MW. notes: Included under broad 'server farm/high-energy compute' interpretation because Baxtel tracks it as a data center and it is a Bitcoin mining compute facility; not confirmed as a conventional colocation/hyperscale data center from county records.

developer: Atlas Development LLC; Prologis identified in project/news materials
status_detail: Coweta DRI #4361 describes Project Sail at Welcome to Sargent Road and Wagers Mill Road as a data center of 13 buildings plus substations, filed by Atlas Development LLC, with estimated completion 12/31/2036 and estimated build-out value $17.16B. After moratorium and ordinance work, local news reports the Coweta Board of Commissioners approved rezoning about 829 acres by 3-2 vote on April 7/8, 2026; project materials now describe 9 buildings and 4.34M sf.
notes: Capacity varies by source: opposition material cites 600 MW, tracker/recent news summaries cite 900 MW. Used 900 MW because multiple 2026 project trackers/news summaries list it, while official DRI did not provide MW.

developer: Land Holding Company LLC; Beltline Energy reported as potential tenant/operator
status_detail: Local reporting and tracker records describe a potential data center tied to the former Boy Scout camp/roughly 500-acre site near Byron and Crawford/Peach jurisdictional dispute; landowner filed agricultural-to-industrial rezoning citing negotiations with Beltline Energy.
